label: Shop or e-commerce
summary: Transparent pricing, shipping details, and return policies
No misleading scarcity tactics or false countdown claims
Clear disclosures for warranties and product specifications
tone_principles: Helpful, engaging, transparent, and fair. Avoid deceptive urgency or hidden terms.
writing_style: Friendly product descriptions with clear specs, delivery estimates, and return guidelines.
messaging_principles: Prices, discounts, and return windows must be stated plainly without deceptive asterisks.
do_examples: Enjoy complimentary standard shipping on orders over qualifying cart amounts.
Returns accepted within 30 days in original condition and packaging.
dont_examples: Lowest prices anywhere in the universe guaranteed—act in 10 seconds or lose it forever!
100% free with zero strings attached and lifetime unlimited refunds!

rules.title: Substantiate Price Guarantees & Promotional Terms
rules.description: Retail promotions must not promise unverified universal price match superlatives.
rules.do_example: Check our competitive pricing on everyday essentials.
rules.dont_example: We guarantee the lowest prices in the world with no exclusions.

rules.title: Avoid Deceptive Scarcity & High-Pressure Urgency
rules.description: Do not manufacture fake countdown urgency or pressure buyers with false stock depletion warnings.

suggested_replacements.order in 3 seconds or lose it: popular item; order early while supplies last

rules.do_example: Available while promotional seasonal stock lasts.
rules.dont_example: Only 1 left—order in 3 seconds or lose it forever!

terminology.prohibited: hassle-free lifetime return guarantee with zero conditions
terminology.notes: Return terms must reflect realistic published warranty guidelines.
State rating averages honestly based on verified purchaser reviews.
